description: Variation of Condition 2 (Approved plans) to make alterations to the external appearance of the blocks and Variation of conditions 17 (drainage strategy) and 18 (sustainable drainage) to allow the alignment of the drawings approved under planning permission 01054/359-363/P8 dated 07/01/2022 for the variation of Condition 2 (approved plans) to allow minor alterations to internal layouts to front and rear blocks, minor elevation changes to reflect internal layout alterations including amendment to floor levels to the rear block, revision to cycle and refuse store layouts and positioning, alterations to external works to include repositioning of car park, access road, communal amenity space and landscaping of planning permission 01054/359-363/P7 dated 17/05/21 for erection of 28 flats within two four storey blocks with associated parking, cycle storage, refuse storage and landscaping
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of planning permission 01054/359-363/P7 dated 17/05/21.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (420/18/FUL/PL1011 Rev D, 420/18/FUL/PL1006 Rev F, 420/18/FUL/PL1005 Rev F, 420/18/FUL/PL1004 Rev G, 420/18/FUL/PL1003 Rev F, 420/18/FUL/PL1002 Rev G; received 20/07/2021 420/18/FUL/PL1008 Rev E, 420/18/FUL/PL1007 Rev E, Design Statement, 420/18/FUL/PL40.01 Rev C, 420/18/FUL/PL50.01 Rev C, 420/18/FUL/PL1000 Transport Not 2018-3302 dated 17th February 2021, 2018-3302-AT-111 Rev A; received 18/05/2021)

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The scheme shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with Desk Study and Ground investigation report REV B. Prepared by T&P Regeneration LTD. Reference: P0667/CS-J-1414. Received: 26/07/2022
Remediation Strategy REV B. Prepared by T&P Regeneration LTD. Reference: P0667/CS-J-1414. Received: 14/09/2022, as approved under application 01054/359-363/P8(3i-25) on 28/09/2022.
 b. The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues. Before the development is first brought into use: 
 c. The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses b) and c) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 6 - The scheme shall be carried out in all respects prior to first occupation in accordance with Details of external works prepared by TAK Structures. Reference: 20452-TAK-D-601. Reference: STR-ULA-00-00-DR-L-1451. Received: 01/06/2022, as approved under application 01054/359-363/P8(5-26) on 28/09/2022.

Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 8 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected or allowed to grow within the areas of these splays on land within the approved development site.

Condition : 9 - The scheme shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with Detailed Construction Logistics Plan REV C. Prepared Paul Mew Associates. Received: 25/08/2022, as approved under application 01054/359-363/P8(5-26) on 28/09/2022.

Condition : 10 - Notwithstanding the approved drawings, before first occupation of the buildings hereby approved, full details (including manufacturers specification) of secure covered cycle parking facilities (for not less than 44 bicycles) for the occupants of the development shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall conform to current guidance such as the West London Cycle Parking Guidance (WestTRANS) in design and layout and be fully implemented and be made available for use before the first occupation of the development and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 11 - Prior to occupation of the hereby approved development a Delivery and Servicing plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and shall include details as to how the plan will be monitored, enforced, reviewed and of a centralised delivery system so that delivery drivers do not have to access individual flats to reduce dwell time so that the limited kerbside space is not oversubscribed. All deliveries and servicing shall be carried out in strict accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 12 - The development hereby permitted shall comply with the principles of 'Secured by Design'. A Secure by Design certificate must be obtained for the development and submitted to the Council prior to first occupation of any part of the premises.

Condition : 13 - The scheme shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with Lifetime homes assessment. Prepared by Howarth Homes. Received: 23/06/2022, Proposed plots 1-14: Floor plans. B) Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure/National Calculation Method) should be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions, and achieved a 35% reduction in emissions.

Condition : 15 - The development shall not be occupied until evidence (schedule of fittings and manufactures literature) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority demonstrating that the development has been constructed to achieve an internal water consumption of the development not exceeding 105 litres per day in line with The Water Efficiency Calculator for new dwellings from the Department of Communities and Local Government.

Condition : 16 - The development shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the approved details (Life cycle impacts of materials checklist for post construction stage. Condition : 17 - The scheme shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with Philosophy and design for foul and surface water discharge Rev D. Prepared by Tak Structures. Received: 21/02/2023, as approved under this application 01054/359-363/P9.

Condition : 18 - The scheme shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with Philosophy and design for foul and surface water discharge Rev D. Prepared by Tak Structures. Received: 21/02/2023, as approved under this application 01054/359-363/P9.

Condition : 19 - No building hereby permitted shall be occupied until evidence (photographs and installation contracts) has been submitted to demonstrate that the sustainable drainage scheme for the site has been completed in accordance with the submitted details. The sustainable drainage scheme shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the agreed management and maintenance plan for all of the proposed drainage components.

Condition : 20 - Before the hereby permitted development is occupied, the details of terrace/balcony privacy screens shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 21 - All of the side facing (west and east facing) windows of the hereby approved building shall be obscure glazed and retained as such thereafter.

Condition : 22 - A. The hereby approved development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the mitigation measures recommended in the submitted Noise Impact Assessment report and the building shall be constructed so as to provide sound insulation against externally generated noise of not less than the standards outlined in BS8233:2014 with windows shut and other means of ventilation provided. The sound insulation works shall be completed before the building is first occupied or brought into use and retained thereafter. 
B. Before any part of the development is occupied, sound insulation test reports, demonstrating compliance with the scheme approved under Part A of this condition, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 23 - Prior to the first occupation of the hereby approved development a Car Park Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and shall include details of an active and passive Electric Vehicle (EV) charging point provision that complies with the London Plan standards, including manufacturers' specification. EV chargers should be capable of a minimum 7.2kW output. The approved details and measures shall be implemented prior to the first occupation of the development and thereafter retained for the duration of the development.

Condition : 24 - No residential unit shall be occupied until details of a scheme of mitigation for the reduction of exposure to poor air quality in bedrooms and living rooms where ventilation is sourced from the Staines Road facade has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and the approved mitigation has been installed. Any system of mitigation shall be designed to demonstrate that the internal air quality will be below the annual mean concentration of NO2 of 40 ?gg/m3. For the first five years, the maintenance and cleaning of the systems shall be undertaken on a minimum of an annual basis following installation in accordance with manufacturer specifications and shall be the responsibility of the primary owner of the property to submit the maintenance records to the Local Planning Authority. Any system of mitigation involving filtration should ideally ensure that air is taken from the rear(north) of the development (cleaner air).

Condition : 25 - The scheme shall be carried out in all respects prior to first occupation of any part of the development in accordance with Air quality assessment, prepared by Aeolus Air Quality Consulting. Received: 19/10/2022, as approved under application 01054/359-363/P8(3i-25) on 23/03/2023.

Condition : 26 - The scheme shall be carried out in all respects prior to first occupation of the development in accordance with Landscape Management & Maintenance Plan REV B. Prepared by Udal Landscape Architecture. Received: 20/09/2022, as approved under application 01054/359-363/P8(5-26) on 28/09/2022.

Condition : 27 - The scheme shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with Written scheme of archaeology prepared by Compass Archaelogy received: 14/04/2022., as approved under application 01054/359-363/P8(27) on 11/08/2022.
